title: The State of Independent Optometry Websites 2026
note: Aggregates computed from automated scans. No individual site is identified.
attribution: Free to use and cite under CC BY 4.0. Credit Clikiti with a link.
citation: Clikiti. (2026, October 15). The state of independent optometry websites 2026 (Q4 2026) [Report]. https://clikiti.com/research/optometry/2026-q4
audience: Web agencies and freelancers selling to independent optometry practices and optical boutiques
findings: Only 7% of the 123 independent optometry websites we scanned show any price: an eye exam, a contact lens fitting or a pair of glasses.
A typical site answers six of the ten questions patients ask before choosing (mean 6).
The median overall score is 77 out of 100 (mean 76).
The least-answered questions are "What will an eye exam cost me?" (7%), "Do other patients vouch for you?" (33%) and "Which frames do you carry?" (50%).
The best-answered are "Can I book an eye exam online?" (86%) and "Can I get contact lenses fitted?" (85%).

By kind of business, the highest median score is 78 (pediatric and vision therapy), against 77 for family optometry practices, 77 for optical boutiques with an optometrist and 74 for specialty contact lens and dry eye.
88% fail "Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone" (Core Web Vitals · LCP).
39% fail "Optician, Optometric or MedicalClinic structured data" (Schema.org · Optician).

agencyProblems.label: A price shown: an exam, a fitting or eyewear
agencyProblems.question: What will an eye exam cost me?
agencyProblems.fix: Publish the self-pay price of a routine eye exam and a contact lens fitting, and a starting price for frames or a glasses package.
agencyProblems.pitch: Chains post their exam price. A patient without vision cover finds no number on your site at all.

agencyProblems.label: Loads in under 2.5 s on a phone
agencyProblems.fix: Resize and compress the hero image, defer scripts, aim for under 2.5 s on a phone.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your home page takes several seconds to appear on a patient’s phone.

agencyProblems.label: Text contrast passes 4.5:1
agencyProblems.fix: Raise text contrast to at least 4.5:1 in the theme.
agencyProblems.pitch: On an eye-care site, faint text is the first thing a low-vision patient meets, and it is a WCAG failure.

agencyProblems.label: Reviews marked up, in a widget or quoted
agencyProblems.question: Do other patients vouch for you?
agencyProblems.fix: Show the practice’s patient reviews on the site, with Review or AggregateRating markup.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your patients already praise you elsewhere. Your own site does not show it.

agencyProblems.label: Frame brands named
agencyProblems.question: Which frames do you carry?
agencyProblems.fix: An eyewear page that names the frame brands and designers you carry, with photographs of the optical.
agencyProblems.pitch: Your frame wall is why people choose you over a chain, and the website does not show it.
